home.title: Trademark Similarity Analyzer
home.intro: A first-pass product prototype for ranking similar trademarks from an official IMPI open-data sample so reviewers can filter possible conflicts faster.
home.sourceNote: Source report {reportId}: {sampledRecordCount} imported records from {rawRecordCount} monthly records.
limitations: This uses a local sample imported from IMPI Datos Abiertos, not a live connection.
This does not query MARCia or Acervo in real time yet.
This does not provide legal conclusions.
This does not analyze logos yet.
The inspected XML sample does not include Nice class, registration number, or goods/services text.
The goal is to validate the expected output and workflow.

results.emptyDescription: Enter a denomination to see ranked mock records and similarity explanations.
results.title: Ranked Results
results.count: {count} mock records sorted by final score.

recordSummary.missingGoodsServices: Nice class and the goods/services description are not present in this open-data sample.

explanations.exactMatch: Exact match with the searched denomination.
explanations.containsQueryNoClass: Contains "{query}". Nice class was not provided in this IMPI open-data sample.
explanations.containsQueryWithClass: Contains "{query}" and belongs to Nice class {niceClass}.
explanations.queryContainsName: The searched denomination contains "{name}", so this shorter mark may be relevant.
explanations.moderate: Moderate textual and phonetic similarity to {query}.
explanations.relatedClass: Lower textual similarity, but the class is related to apparel, retail, bags, or sporting goods.
explanations.lowSimilarity: Different brand name, low textual similarity.
